caption:
Every piece of content has a half-life.

A story: gone in 24 hours.
A reel or post: most of its reach in the first days.
A YouTube video or blog answer: found for years through search.
A Google review: working for you as long as your business exists.

Most small businesses spend 90% of their effort on the shortest-lived content and almost none on the longest.

A smarter split:
→ Stories and reels to stay top of mind
→ One evergreen video or page answering the question every customer asks
→ A simple system to ask every happy customer for a review

The review you get today will still be selling for you in five years.

📌 Send this to someone who posts every day but has 12 Google reviews.
